As a web and UX/UI designer, I have worked on several projects, including website redesign and UX/UI design. Notable projects include the redesign of the Children's Music School website, where I created a visually appealing and easy-to-navigate landing page, and Pet-Saver-Hub, a web service for rescuing lost and found animals, where I designed a user-friendly interface for searching lost or found pets.

In the Children's Music School website redesign, I conducted a thorough analysis of the existing website, identifying its strengths and weaknesses, and created a detailed wireframe of the new landing page. I incorporated a news block and a prominent call to action, ensuring consistency with the school's brand identity through careful selection of color scheme and typography. I then focused on the visual design of the landing page, prioritizing user experience and ease of navigation, and ensured that important information was easily accessible and incorporated responsive design principles for a seamless user experience across devices.

For Pet-Saver-Hub, I conducted user research to identify key pain points and created a detailed user flow and wireframe, ensuring an intuitive and easy-to-navigate user interface. I incorporated interactive elements, such as a map feature, to facilitate the search process.

Through my experience, I have developed skills in wireframing, visual design, user research, and responsive design. I am eager to further develop my UI/UX design skills and contribute to projects with significance and impact. I look forward to collaborating with professionals who can help me grow and learn, and to participating in challenging projects that allow me to develop my creative potential and stay updated with the latest design technologies and trends.

I value effective communication and teamwork, recognizing their importance in achieving results. I intend to actively engage with users, collecting feedback to improve the user experience, and understand the crucial role of creativity and attention to detail in the design process. I am committed to delivering high-quality work through maximum effort.
